headline: 17 active wildfires are burning uncontained in the US today. The most serious is the Aspen Acres Fire in CO, threatening 100 structures.

active_threats.name: Aspen Acres
active_threats.narrative: The Aspen Acres Fire in Custer County, CO has burned 103,070 acres and is 96% contained. NIFC's incident team reports **100 structures threatened**. 1 personnel are assigned. Winds are expected to stay comparatively light over the next 24 hours (gusts near 22 mph), which should limit further wind-driven spread for now. A wind shift is expected during the window — the kind of transition that is hardest for a 3 km forecast model to time and place precisely. Forecast wind direction (NW, blowing toward the SE) favors pushing the fire toward Colorado City CDP, 14 miles away.

emerging_conditions.narrative: A fire-weather pattern is developing over AR: Little Rock city, Jonesboro city, Benton city, Paragould city, and Jacksonville city and 12 other communities sit under NIFC's Significant Fire Potential outlook (day 2). USGS fire-danger models put the local large-fire/spread probability as high as 1% in spots. No fire has been reported yet, but the combination of dry fuels and elevated fire weather is exactly the kind that produces a fast-moving run if an ignition occurs.
